name: Tome of Divinity
summary: In Ironforge, dwarf paladins return for deeper training in the Holy Light. Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker sends them home, and Tiza Battleforge guides them toward the sacred trials of the Tome of Divinity.

sections.title: A Summons Home
sections.body: Dwarf paladins keep their spiritual and martial roots in Khaz Modan, even when they serve Stormwind or travel through human lands. When Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker judges that a dwarf has gained enough field training, he sends them home. There they learn the duties expected of a full Knight of the Silver Hand.

sections.title: The Hall of Mysteries
sections.body: In Ironforge, you are directed to the Mystic Ward and the Hall of Mysteries. Tiza Battleforge waits upstairs, where she mentors young dwarven paladins. She prepares them to bear the burden of the Holy Light through sacred trials recorded in the Tome of Divinity.

faq.q: Why does Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker send me back to Ironforge?
faq.answer: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker sends you back because dwarven paladins learn the deeper tenets and trials of the Holy Light from their own kin. Tiza Battleforge guides that training.
Tiza Battleforge is one of Ironforge's most respected dwarven paladins. She mentors young paladins upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries and oversees their trials.

faq.q: Where can I find Tiza Battleforge?
faq.answer: You can find Tiza Battleforge upstairs in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge's Mystic Ward.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity?
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity records the holy teachings and trials paladins undergo to master the Holy Light, especially resurrection and devotion to fallen allies.

faq.q: Can human paladins do this version of the quest?
faq.answer: No. This summons directs dwarven paladins to their homeland's instructors. Human paladins pursue their trials with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker and Duthorian Rall in Stormwind.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Tiza Battleforge?
aliases: next quest after tome of divinity
faq.answer: After you introduce yourself to Tiza Battleforge, she gives you formal dwarven trials from the Tome of Divinity. They test your readiness to wield the Light's redemptive power.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you return from human lands to Ironforge, your ancestral home in Khaz Modan, to train under your own elders.
As a paladin, you begin a major rite of passage by studying the Tome of Divinity and mastering the gift of resurrection.
As an Alliance member, you see the close spiritual ties between dwarves and humans in the shared training and mutual respect between Stormwind's paladins and Ironforge's mentors.
